snippet.title: Night of the Living Toys – Co-op Sorting in the Haunted Toy Store | Steam
snippet.description:
Wishlist the game now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3122680/Night_of_the_Living_Toys/

🧸 Welcome to Night of the Living Toys! Dig through a mountain of toys and get everything onto the shelves before the store opens. Play solo or with a team of up to four. But remember: this store has a secret, and it must be kept! Night shift at a toy store. The shelves are empty and toys are scattered everywhere. Put things in order and find out what really happened here.
